📺 Black Bird (2022)

Black Bird follows Jimmy Keene, a former high school football star whose life takes a dramatic turn when he is sentenced to ten years in prison for drug-related crimes. While serving his sentence, Jimmy receives an extraordinary offer from federal authorities: transfer to a maximum-security prison, gain the trust of suspected serial killer Larry Hall, and convince him to reveal information about his alleged victims. In exchange, Jimmy could earn his freedom. As he enters a dangerous environment filled with violent criminals and psychological manipulation, he must carefully build a relationship with Larry while protecting his true identity and confronting disturbing secrets. Starring Taron Egerton and Paul Walter Hauser, the series delivers gripping suspense, powerful performances, and an emotional story about justice, survival, deception, and the pursuit of truth.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Thriller • Mystery

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 48–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Dennis Lehane

📚 Based On: In with the Devil by James Keene and Hillel Levin

🏆 Awards: Paul Walter Hauser won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Limited Series.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV+ in the United States.
